question: Find the value of: 47−¹¹ ÷ 47¹⁶ × 47−¹⁰
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For operations on the same base, process exponents left to right based on BODMAS.

Apply rule: am ÷ aⁿ × ap = am − ⁿ ⁺ p

⇒ 47−¹¹ − ¹⁶ − ¹⁰

⇒ 47−³⁷

**∴ The correct answer is 47−³⁷.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 47−¹¹ ÷ 47¹⁶ × 47−¹⁰

**Formula Used:**

According to the laws of exponents:

1. am ÷ aⁿ = am − ⁿ

2. am × aⁿ = am ⁺ ⁿ

**Calculations:**

Evaluate the division first, moving from left to right:

⇒ (47−¹¹ ÷ 47¹⁶) × 47−¹⁰

⇒ 47⁽−¹¹ − ¹⁶⁾ × 47−¹⁰

⇒ 47−²⁷ × 47−¹⁰

Now evaluate the multiplication:

⇒ 47⁽−²⁷ ⁺ ⁽−¹⁰⁾⁾

⇒ 47−³⁷

**∴ The correct answer is 47−³⁷.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule of Exponents

When multiplying terms with the same base, add their exponents: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

Quotient Rule of Exponents

When dividing terms with the same base, subtract the exponent of the divisor from the dividend: am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

Power of a Power Rule

When raising a power to another power, multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am × ⁿ

Negative Exponent Rule

A negative exponent indicates the reciprocal of the base raised to the positive exponent: a−ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ
